an5.151:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an5.151:1.3: kathaṃ paribhoti. kathikaṃ paribhoti. attānaṃ paribhoti. vikkhittacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti anekaggacitto. ayoniso ca manasikaroti
an5.151:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an5.151:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an5.151:2.3: na kathaṃ paribhoti. na kathikaṃ paribhoti. na attānaṃ paribhoti. avikkhittacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti ekaggacitto. yoniso ca manasikaroti.
an5.151:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattanti.
